author: Carolina
title: Looking for 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content: Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator! I’m looking for a creative talent who can: Create flat character illustrations (2D). Design and develop 3D characters. Animate characters in both 2D and 3D. Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus. If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com

author: Hayley Quinn
title: Seeking artist for two fantasy characters scene
content: NO DMS. Strict budget up to $300 & looking for someone to accept half payment before starting. Looking for an artist in a semi realistic/realistic art style to draw two characters in a fantasy setting from Danielle L. Jensen’s new duology Defy The Dusk. The focus will be on the two characters in a dancing scene, and background will be minimal. This will be for personal use & there is no deadline. Please share your portfolio so I can get a sense of your style. Thank you!
